answers.rationale: No fixed downtown-hotel avoidance is supported. With no car, 8:00 sessions, a 9:30 reception end, and an indoor connection to the venue, the official downtown hotel minimizes repeated late-night and early-morning transfers; breakfast and suburban savings are secondary.

This is an itinerary-specific suburban routing choice, not a standing anti-downtown preference. With a rental car, early school visits concentrated in Tempe/Chandler/Mesa, and downtown Phoenix adding $45 valet, the Chandler breakfast-and-free-parking option is operationally better.

No car, a downtown seminar, a 9:45 downtown dinner, and a 7:40 King Street departure make location more valuable than included breakfast. A downtown hotel avoids late transfers and supports the early train; airport or Bellevue lodging would add unnecessary transit risk.
